layout.scene: A café seating area with a rectangular table parallel to a window. A tall floor plant marks one short end, the counter lies beyond the other, and an open aisle runs opposite the window. No other people are nearby.
layout.public_intro: Inside a café, a rectangular table stands beside the window, with a tall floor plant near one end and the counter beyond the other.

establish.public_view: Wide establishing shot from the counter end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the floor plant, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

partial_pair.public_view: Medium two-shot from the aisle side, centered on the two adjacent window-side seats.

partial_first.public_view: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person in the plant-side window seat.

partial_second.public_view: Close-up from the aisle side, centered on the person in the counter-side window seat.

probe_reverse.public_view: Reverse wide shot from the plant end, looking lengthwise along the rectangular table toward the café counter, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.

probe_overhead.public_view: Top-down wide shot from directly above the rectangular table, centered on the tabletop, with both window-side seats and both aisle-side seats in frame.
